programme.title: DTM Show 2025 Norisring Part 2
programme.desc: DTM. The embodiment of Motorsport tradition. Having just turned 40, the DTM combines a unique fascination and familiarity with an unmistakable dynamic, signified by the rebranding with a new logo! Seven different manufacturers – ten different winners on six brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Lamborghini, Porsche and Ferrari) through twelve races are but one testament to the unique competitive balance that makes every DTM weekend a revelation! And with the addition of Ford, the palette of different brands is only increasing!

programme.title: Milan vs Crvena Zvezda - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD6
programme.desc: Milan have faced Crvena Zvezda on six previous occasions in Europe, going unbeaten across each of those matches. Including qualifiers, the only side they’ve faced more times in European competition without ever losing is Sparta Prague. Crvena Zvezda have only won one of their 14 away matches against Italian sides in Europe, with that lone victory coming against Chievo in October 2002 in the UEFA Cup.

Should Monaco fail to win this game, Benfica will become the team they have faced most often in major European competition without managing a victory.

programme.title: Atalanta vs Club Brugge - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 Knoch Out Play-offs - 2nd Leg

programme.title: PSV vs Juventus - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 Knoch Out Play-offs - 2nd Leg
programme.desc: 21% of Manuel Locatelli’s passes in the UEFA Champions League this season have broken at least one opposition line; the highest percentage by any player in 2024-25. Indeed, the Juventus man is one of only three midfielders with 100+ line-breaking passes in the competition overall this term, along with Joshua Kimmich and Angelo Stiller. In the form of Francisco Conceição and Kenan Yildiz, this is the first UEFA Champions League campaign since 2014-15 in which two Juventus players have both completed 20+ dribbles – Carlos Tevez and Álvaro Morata both did so that season, in a team that finished as runners-up.

Brest trail by three goals in this tie against Paris SG, following their first leg defeat. No side has ever progressed from a two-legged UEFA Champions League knockout stage tie, having lost the first leg at home by three or more goals.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Manchester City - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 Knoch Out Play-offs - 2nd Leg

programme.title: Brest vs Lens - French Ligue 1 2024/25 Week 30

programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab.Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan

programme.desc: Don't miss ONE Friday Fights 118 as the world's largest martial arts organization brings MMA, kickboxing, and Muay Thai back to Bangkok. Plus, British rising star Otis Waghorn takes on French-Moroccan sensation Hakim Bah, who has won his last seven fights!

programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just one of their last 12 Premier League meetings with Liverpool, beating them 2-1 at Old Trafford in their third game of the 2022-23 campaign. Liverpool have lost just one of their last six Premier League away games against Manchester United, while only Manchester City have won away at Old Trafford more often than the Reds in the competition’s history.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. Having lost each of their first six Premier League visits to the Etihad Stadium, Crystal Palace have lost just two of their last six away to Man City in the competition.

programme.title: Villarreal / Real Madrid
programme.desc: Less than 72 hours after its qualification for the quarterfinals of the Champions League, Real Madrid (2nd) must quickly get back into the Liga bath with a complicated trip to Villarreal (5th), still well placed in the C1 race. The Merengues are counting on a revanchard vinicius after its missed penalty against Atlético de Madrid, ready to prove its value. Aurélien Tchouameni, who has become essential in the midfield, plays a key role in the structure of Carlo Ancelotti's game. Finally, Kylian Mbappé, in search of his 30th goal under the Madrid colors, is more motivated than ever to extend his series. With these assets, Real hopes to start from the Estadio de la Cerámica with the three points and temporarily take the head of the Liga. For his part, Villarreal is betting on the experience of Dani Parejo to orchestrate the game in the middle, while the former Newcastle player, Ayoze Pérez, author of 11 goals this season, and the magic winger Nicolas Pépé, will be offensive weapons ...

programme.title: Portugal / France
programme.desc: The 2025 Euro Espoirs opens with a summit. In search of a title that has been fleeing them since 1988, Gérald Batic's blueberries are starting their campaign against Portugal, one of the big favorites in the tournament. programme.title: Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs / Manly-Warringah Sea Eagles
programme.desc: Retransmission of a NRL match, the Australian National Rugby Championship in XIII. The National Rugby League is one of the most prestigious XIII rugby competitions in the world with the Super League. Born in 1998 from the merger of Australian Rugby League (ARL) and the Australian Super League, the NRL is based on a franchise system in a closed and without possible relegation championship. Sixteen franchises make up this championship.

programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.

programme.title: Finale
programme.desc: The WTA tournament from Washington or Citi Open has been around since 1972. It has argued on clay then today on hard and serves as preparation for the US Open. The tournament is classified in the WTA 500 category and knows how to attract the best players in the American capital.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.
